Mantine NavigationProgress (progress bar at the top of the page)

Source: R/NProgress.R
NavigationProgress.Rd

Should be inserted once in the UI (typically inside MantineProvider(), the same way as Notifications()); it is then driven from the server with the imperative functions startMantineProgress(), setMantineProgress(), incrementMantineProgress(), decrementMantineProgress(), completeMantineProgress(), and resetMantineProgress().

Usage

NavigationProgress(...)

startMantineProgress(session = shiny::getDefaultReactiveDomain())

setMantineProgress(value, session = shiny::getDefaultReactiveDomain())

incrementMantineProgress(
  value = NULL,
  session = shiny::getDefaultReactiveDomain()
)

decrementMantineProgress(
  value = NULL,
  session = shiny::getDefaultReactiveDomain()
)

completeMantineProgress(session = shiny::getDefaultReactiveDomain())

resetMantineProgress(session = shiny::getDefaultReactiveDomain())

Arguments

...

Optional props (color, size, zIndex, ...). See https://mantine.dev/x/nprogress/.

session

Shiny session.

value

Percentage value (0-100).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# ui:
MantineProvider(NavigationProgress(), ...)

# server:
observeEvent(input$go, {
  startMantineProgress(session)
  ...
  completeMantineProgress(session)
})
} # }
